How cloud updates work
The GitHub HTML becomes the permanent launcher. A JSON manifest can point to a newer report template plus one or more CSS and JavaScript files stored in Supabase Storage or another CORS-enabled public location. If the remote files cannot load, the embedded builder remains available as a fallback.

Firmographic segmentation
Classifies accounts by employee count first, then uses annual revenue as a supporting validation signal. If company data is missing, the builder can attempt free public enrichment before building the report.
Leave blank to skip Companies House. The key remains only in the open builder session and is never embedded in the exported report.
No public enrichment has been run. Uploaded employee size/count and annual revenue will be used first.
Public-source stack: Wikidata for domain matching and available firmographics; GLEIF for legal-entity / LEI verification; SEC EDGAR for U.S. public-company revenue; XBRL International filings for additional structured public-company revenue when an LEI can be resolved; IRS Form 990 for nonprofit revenue when an EIN is mapped; and optional Companies House verification for UK entities. Public coverage varies, so missing or unsupported values remain Insufficient Data rather than being guessed. Revenue from public filings is used only when it can be treated as a U.S.-dollar value. Each run checks up to 100 new domains to respect public services; run enrichment again if more remain.
